name: Jess Moore
source:
Jessica is the daughter of Darcy Moore and Annabelle. She is 17 years old and is dating her girlfriend Katherine. 
One of her main interests include writing; she carries her sticker-bombed journal everywhere to jot down words at random times. She also seems to be very into the music scene, going to music festivals and wearing a shirt that looks to resemble the musician 'Buckethead'.
